parts.name: Link
parts.description: A styled anchor with optional corner arrow and hover line. Primary and secondary appearances reuse button styles without press scaling. Native anchor attributes are forwarded.

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation destination.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size: small, medium or large.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Text link or button-styled primary/secondary anchor, without press scaling.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Show a decorative arrow at the upper-right edge of the link text.

props.name: underline
props.description: Enables the animated underline on hover or keyboard focus. The anchor never has a persistent underline.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context for the linked destination, such as _self or _blank.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship tokens. New-window links also receive noopener noreferrer.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: Link.Container
parts.description: A semantic anchor that provides hover, focus and size context without button appearance. Compose Link.Underline inside it.

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation destination.

props.name: size
props.description: Size context used by nested Link.Underline elements; adds no button appearance.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context for the linked destination, such as _self or _blank.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship tokens. New-window links also receive noopener noreferrer.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

props.name: underline
props.description: Enables the animated underline on hover or keyboard focus. The anchor never has a persistent underline.

parts.name: Link.Underline
parts.description: A span drawing a straight underline when its Link.Container is hovered or focus-visible. Small and medium sizes use the same line thickness.

props.name: size
props.description: Override the container’s size for this underline. Small and medium use equal line thickness.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
